policy: Official Toyota U.S. retail, full-spec, brochure, Owners and Toyota USA Newsroom sources are primary. Official Toyota Canada current-model product information may be used only to cross-check physical North American body dimensions when the U.S. page exposes the category but not machine-readable values; such entries are labelled as North American configuration ranges. Missing or non-applicable fields are explicitly marked; no values are inferred.

brand_fields.warranty: Basic: 3 years/36,000 miles; powertrain: 5 years/60,000 miles; rust-through: 5 years/unlimited miles. Hybrid-related components: 8 years/100,000 miles; hybrid battery: 10 years/150,000 miles where applicable. Refer to the model Warranty & Maintenance Guide for terms and emissions coverage.

Camry.efficiency: Up to 51 EPA-estimated combined MPG on LE FWD
Camry.dimensions: 193.5 in L × 72.4 in W × 56.9 in H; 111.2 in wheelbase (LE Hybrid comparison specification)
Camry.technology: Toyota Audio Multimedia; available 9-speaker JBL Premium Audio; equipment varies by grade
Camry.gallery_usage_note: Toyota USA Newsroom media assets are designated for editorial use. Keep the source association and do not repurpose them as advertising creative.

Corolla Cross.torque_lb_ft: 151 lb-ft (gas engine; Toyota does not publish one combined hybrid-system torque figure on the model overview)
Corolla Cross.efficiency: Up to 32 combined MPG gas FWD / up to 42 combined MPG hybrid
Corolla Cross.dimensions: 176.1 in L × 71.9 in W × 64.9 in H; 103.9 in wheelbase
Corolla Cross.cargo: 24.0 cu ft behind the rear seat; configuration-dependent with seats folded
Corolla Cross.technology: Toyota Audio Multimedia with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility; equipment varies by grade

Prius.horsepower: 194 net combined hp (FWD) / 196 net combined hp (AWD)
Prius.efficiency: EPA-estimated 55 combined MPG on LE trim
Prius.dimensions: 181.1 in L × 70.2 in W × up to 56.3 in H; 108.3 in wheelbase
Prius.cargo: Up to 23.8 cu ft on LE trim with rear seats up
Prius.technology: 8.0-in Toyota Audio Multimedia display on LE; available larger display and Qi wireless charging on upper grades

4Runner.efficiency: Up to 23 combined MPG depending on powertrain and grade
4Runner.dimensions: North American configurations: 194.9 in L × 77.9 in W × approximately 72.6–73.6 in H; 112.2 in wheelbase. Height varies with powertrain/grade equipment.

Highlander.transmission: Direct Shift-8AT 8-speed electronically controlled automatic (2.4L turbo gas) / electronically controlled CVT (hybrid)
Highlander.efficiency: Up to 35 combined MPG on hybrid grades; gas grades are configuration-dependent
Highlander.dimensions: 194.9 in L × 76.0 in W × 68.1 in H; 112.2 in wheelbase
Highlander.cargo: 16.0 cu ft behind the third row; up to 84.3 cu ft with rear seats folded
Highlander.technology: Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility; available 12.3-in Toyota Audio Multimedia display

Tacoma.efficiency: EPA-estimated city/highway ratings vary by grade; selected i-FORCE MAX grades reach 22/24 MPG
Tacoma.dimensions: North American current-generation configurations: 213.0 in overall length with 5-ft bed or XtraCab 6-ft bed; 226.2 in for Double Cab long-bed configuration; 131.9 or 145.1 in wheelbase; width/height vary by grade, tires and off-road equipment.
Tacoma.technology: Available 14-in Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen; hybrid grades include a 2400W AC power supply
Tacoma.safety: Toyota Safety Sense suite standard; equipment varies by grade
